name: A7
description: The Audi A7 Sportback (2010–present) is the four-door fastback in the A6 range — the Gran Turismo alternative to the A6 saloon. Its C7 (4G) and C8 (4K) generations offer TFSI/TDI powertrains and plug-in hybrid variants alongside performance S7 and RS7 derivatives.
